$comment: Self-derived finetype drift contract for ons/soc_2020_titles, checked by the in-engine finetype_validate@1 gate (the model-free `ft_validate` DuckDB table macro). ft_validate MELTS every column to VARCHAR, so this contract uses ONLY the string-surviving JSON-Schema keywords. ENFORCED: the `pattern` on entry_id (ONS's id, lowercase letters and digits), on code (four digits), on soc_2020_ext (four digits, a slash, two digits) and on the earlier editions' and ISCO-08 codes, the shapes soc_2020_titles.overrides.json publishes; the closed `enum` domains on text_source and default_flag; the release pattern; and `minLength`/`maxLength` envelopes on the text. NOT ENFORCED, by design: numeric ranges and booleans (a numeric `type` BACKFIRES to 100% reject once melted to VARCHAR); NULLs (invisible to ft_validate); and object-level `required` (documentation only). Free-text fields carry LOOSE length envelopes with headroom. Derived from build/stage/soc_2020_titles.parquet on ONS's files of 2026-11-03: a pass-through on today's rows, a fail-closed tripwire for future drift (a code of another width, a new default mark, an unparsed release).
title: ons/soc_2020_titles
